import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv(pd.compat.StringIO("""brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type

Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless

# Set up the style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# Create a 2x3 subplot layout
# 1. Price vs Megapixels with brand color coding
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
brands = data['brand'].unique()
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", len(brands))
for i, brand in enumerate(brands):
    brand_data = data[data['brand'] == brand]
    ax1.scatter(brand_data['megapixels'], brand_data['price_usd'], 
               s=150, label=brand, alpha=0.7, color=colors[i])
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(fontsize=8)

# 2. Weight vs Price colored by body type
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
body_types = data['body_type'].unique()
for body in body_types:
    body_data = data[data['body_type'] == body]
    ax2.scatter(body_data['weight_grams'], body_data['price_usd'], 
               s=150, label=body, alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Price vs Weight by Body Type', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(fontsize=8)

# 3. Model Year distribution
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
ax3.bar(range(len(data)), data['model_year'], color=colors[:len(data)], alpha=0.7)
ax3.set_xlabel('Camera Index', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Model Year', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('Model Year Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xticks(range(len(data)))
ax3.set_xticklabels(data['brand'], rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)

# 4. Sensor Type distribution
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
sensor_counts = data['sensor_type'].value_counts()
ax4.bar(range(len(sensor_counts)), sensor_counts.values, color=sns.color_palette("muted", len(sensor_counts)))
ax4.set_xlabel('Sensor Type', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Sensor Type Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xticks(range(len(sensor_counts)))
ax4.set_xticklabels(sensor_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)

# 5. Max ISO comparison
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
bars = ax5.barh(range(len(data)), data['max_iso'], color=colors[:len(data)], alpha=0.7)
ax5.set_ylabel('Camera', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_xlabel('Max ISO', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Max ISO Capability', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_yticks(range(len(data)))
ax5.set_yticklabels([f"{b} ({y})" for b, y in zip(data['brand'], data['model_year'])], fontsize=8)

# 6. 4K Video capability pie chart
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
video_4k_counts = data['has_video_4k'].value_counts()

ax6.set_title('4K Video Capability', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
